item.title: Singularity Rootkit: Evading Elastic Defend Module Load Detection
item.description: Elastic Defend 9.5 added taint_flags to the module_load BPF event and a new detection rule on top of it. Here is how Singularity loads clean: source obfuscation for YARA, trusted_pids insertion for the BPF hook, and OBF_OUT=/var/lib/dkms for the .ko creation rule.

item.title: BPF Map Poisoning: Attacking Falco from the Inside
item.description: Rewriting Falco's BPF map state from userspace to suppress syscall monitoring without touching the eBPF program.

item.title: Breaking eBPF Security: How Kernel Rootkits Blind Observability Tools
item.description: Deep technical analysis of bypassing eBPF-based security solutions through kernel-level hooks targeting BPF iterators, ringbuffers, and perf events
